title: PaperPulse: Autonomous Nightly Scientific Literature Ingestion, Knowledge-Graph Synthesis & Claim Verification Engine
description: PaperPulse is an open-source scientific literature digest and knowledge-graph engine developed by the Computational Genomics & Agentic Systems (CGAS) Lab at Northwestern University. It executes autonomous nightly ingestion across ArXiv, Semantic Scholar, PubMed, and OpenAlex, indexing full text in PostgreSQL with pgvector and constructing a multi-hop citation-concept graph in Neo4j to provide verifiable citation provenance and claim-level grounding for scientific research queries.
